item.title: When should you stop saying Happy New Year?
item.description: THREE KEY FACTS In the Gregorian calendar, the first day of the new year is January 1. New Year’s Day is officially January 1, like Christmas is December 25. We don’t say “Merry Christmas” on December 31. “Happy New Year” has somehow become a go-to greeting for the whole of January. If you say “Happy New Year” to me in February, I will block you.
